patch.content:
# Enable for RTC test
CONFIG_FS_FATFS_HAS_RTC=y
CONFIG_TEST_RTC_DRIVER=y

# File system
CONFIG_FILE_SYSTEM=y
CONFIG_FAT_FILESYSTEM_ELM=y
CONFIG_FS_FATFS_LFN=y
CONFIG_FS_FATFS_LFN_HEAP=y
CONFIG_FS_FATFS_ALLOC_PREDEF_HEAP=y
CONFIG_HEAP_MEM_POOL_SIZE=1024

# Disk
CONFIG_DISK_DRIVER_RAM=y
CONFIG_DISK_RAM_VOLUME_SIZE=16
CONFIG_DISK_RAM_VOLUME_NAME="RAM"
